title: Rezoning map change for 2950 West 24th Street, Brooklyn
summary: This application would amend the zoning map to change an R6 and R6/C1-2 district to R6, R7-3, and R7-3/C2-4 districts at 2950 West 24th Street in Coney Island, Brooklyn. Combined with related actions, it would facilitate an 18-story mixed-use building with 408 income-restricted apartments, ground-floor community and commercial space, and open space.
